narrative: - He was from Norman, Oklahoma. Took over a poorly drafted, aging team from Pat-Med and took it to the Toilet Bowl in our 1st season. No where to go but up and that is exactly what Corey did. He took a 5-14 opening season to an overall 80-53 win/loss record before he left the league in 2012. 3-4 in the Playoffs making it 5 times in 7 seasons and 4 division champs. He made it to 2 Super Bowls in Seasons 3 & 4, winning it all in Season 4. He doesn't hold any records or season Awards but he was very competitive and a vital part of this league. There was no drama with Huron. A stable owner for the growth of this league.
